task.title: Listing logs as a superuser with the Red Hat Quay API
task.shortdesc: To list usage logs or obtain registry size information in Red Hat Quay, you can use the superuser logs and registry size API endpoints.

ul.li: You have created an OAuth access token.
You are logged into your Red Hat Quay deployment as a superuser.

step.cmd: Use the GET /api/v1/superuser/logs endpoint to list the usage logs for the current system:

info.codeblock: {"start_time": "Mon, 17 Feb 2025 19:29:14 -0000", "end_time": "Wed, 19 Feb 2025 19:29:14 -0000", "logs": [{"kind": "login_success", "metadata": {"type": "quayauth", "useragent": "Mozilla/5.0 (X11; Linux x86_64; rv:134.0) Gecko/20100101 Firefox/134.0"}, "ip": "192.168.1.131", "datetime": "Tue, 18 Feb 2025 19:28:15 -0000", "namespace": {"kind": "user", "name": "quayadmin", "avatar": {"name": "quayadmin", "hash": "6d640d802fe23b93779b987c187a4b7a4d8fbcbd4febe7009bdff58d84498fba", "color": "#f7b6d2", "kind": "user"}}}], "next_page": "gAAAAABntN-KbPJDI0PpcHmWjRCmQTLiCprE_KXiOSidbGZ7Ireu8pVTgGUIstijNhmiLzlAv_S3HOsCrKWnuBmoQYZ3F53Uxg=="}

step.cmd: Use the GET /api/v1/superuser/registrysize/ endpoint to obtain information about the size of the registry:
Use the POST /api/v1/superuser/registrysize/ endpoint to define registry size information:

info.codeblock: $ curl -X POST "https://quay-server.example.com/api/v1/superuser/registrysize/" \ -H "Authorization: Bearer <ACCESS_TOKEN>" \ -H "Content-Type: application/json" \ -d '{ "namespace": "<namespace>", "last_ran": 1700000000, "queued": true, "running": false }'
info.p: This command does not return output in the CLI.
